title: Crime and Punishment
synopsis: St. Petersburg, summer. You are a starving student. You think, very seriously, that some men are above the law. You decide to test the theory on a pawnbroker.

nodes.text: A coffin of a room. Heat. Debts. You write a strange article on theory.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Path.
“Burn it” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Wise.

nodes.text: Alyona, mean, alone. You pawn a watch.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Cold.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.

nodes.text: A drunk in a tavern. Sonia, his daughter, doing what she has to.

choices.consequence: “Drink with him” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Compassion.
You commit to “Walk out.” The story records the instinct as “Cold” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Dunya, your sister, is engaged to a man who is, plainly, a creditor.

choices.consequence: “Refuse the help” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Pride.
There is no taking “Accept” back. Practical shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: You bring the axe under your coat.

choices.consequence: “Go” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Path.
There is no taking “Don't” back. Honest shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: She opens it. The room is small. You strike.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Path.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Wise.

nodes.text: Her sister returns. You strike again.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honest—follows you into whatever comes next.
There is no taking “Don't think” back. Survive shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: The hallway. Footsteps. You hide behind an empty door.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Hide” back. Smart shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Brave—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: You sleep for days, fevered. The blood on your sock.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Burn the sock” back. Smart shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.

nodes.text: Your friend. He nurses you.

choices.consequence: “Tell him part” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.
There is no taking “Tell him nothing” back. Pride shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: The investigator. He smiles. He talks of theory.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Smart.
You commit to “Confess.” The story records the instinct as “Honest” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: You meet her. You read Lazarus together.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.
You commit to “Don't yet.” The story records the instinct as “Pride” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: She tells you to kiss the earth at the crossroads and confess.

choices.consequence: “Promise” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Path.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Pride—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: He arrives. He has, you fear, your worst self in him.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Wise—follows you into whatever comes next.
There is no taking “Talk to him” back. Curious shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: He corners your sister. She holds a pistol.

choices.consequence: “Trust she'll do what's needed” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honor.
You commit to “Intervene.” The story records the instinct as “Brother” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: He shoots himself in the morning.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Survive.

nodes.text: You hold her face. You don't tell her.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Be gentle.” The story records the instinct as “Care” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Pride—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: You kiss the earth. People stare.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honor.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Pride.

nodes.text: You confess.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honor.
You commit to “Tell it half.” The story records the instinct as “Pride” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Eight years. A wide river. Sonia, who came with you, lives in a hut nearby.

choices.text: Read the New Testament she gave you
choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Path.
There is no taking “Hold out” back. Pride shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Spring on the riverbank. You realize you love her.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Path.
There is no taking “Sit alone” back. Pride shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: You serve your sentence. You return, eventually, with Sonia. You become, the rest of your life, a quiet man who teaches mathematics in a small town and means it when he says 'good morning.'
You write a different article in the prison, on conscience instead of theory. It is, when smuggled out, debated for a century.
You serve your time and disappear into a Siberian village. You die there old. Sonia is buried beside you. The villagers, who never knew, called you a kind man.
